export async function mapLimit<T>(
	items: T[],
	width: number,
	operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
) {
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				await operation(

					// line 30 it's "q" await

					// line 33 it's "q" await

					// line 71 it's "q" await
					// line 72 it's "q" await
					// line 73 it's "q" await
					// line 74 it's "q" await
